title: New routines after the old account

captions.physics: Caring for everyday life at home

meaning: The need to change your domestic routine becomes clearer when disputes over equality reveal rules that no longer fit your lives.
text: Your shared home is sustained by care for practical needs: clean clothes, food and everyday comfort. The Empress in the physical position of Muladhara describes this living work. Justice in energy creates tension through a demand that duties match precisely: everything should be allocated and fulfilled without deviation. Judgement in emotions brings a feeling that the old arrangement needs reconsidering. A wish for a different routine may be growing within, even while the familiar argument still concerns who broke the previous agreement.

For example, you once divided household jobs equally by day. Your schedules have since changed, but every missed turn needs an explanation, as though the conditions were unchanged. **Sometimes fairness means agreeing the arrangement itself afresh.** Behind the discussion of laundry and dinner lies a simple fact: the old division no longer supports your current lives. Recognising this can bring clarity before a new way has fully taken shape or become familiar to both of you.

The vulnerable point is demanding acknowledgement of every past breach before allowing change. The emerging sense of a fresh beginning becomes tied to delivering a final verdict on the past. Your routine stays uncomfortable while you seek an impeccable settlement of the account. Reconsideration offers support when it recognises work already given without requiring proof of who was right in every earlier disagreement.
